title: AI Grid: MaaS
description: Models-as-a-Service path on the ingress sites: MaaS gateway requests, rate limiting (Limitador and its Redis), authentication (Authorino), maas-api, maas-db.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster) (rate(istio_requests_total{cluster=~"$cluster", source_workload=~"maas-default-gateway.*", reporter="source", response_code="429"}[5m])) / sum by (cluster) (rate(istio_requests_total{cluster=~"$cluster", source_workload=~"maas-default-gateway.*", reporter="source"}[5m]))

panels.title: Gateway requests (Istio, MaaS gateway as source)
Requests/s by destination and response code

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, destination_service_name, response_code) (rate(istio_requests_total{cluster=~"$cluster", source_workload=~"maas-default-gateway.*", reporter="source", destination_service_name=~"$model"}[5m]))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (cluster, destination_service_name, le) (rate(istio_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", source_workload=~"maas-default-gateway.*", reporter="source", destination_service_name=~"$model"}[5m])))
sum by (cluster, response_flags, destination_service_name) (rate(istio_requests_total{cluster=~"$cluster", source_workload=~"maas-default-gateway.*", reporter="source", response_flags!="-"}[5m]))

panels.title: Rate limiting (Limitador counters carry model, subscription and user)
Authorized vs limited calls/s by model

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, limitador_namespace) (rate(limited_calls{cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m])) / (sum by (cluster, limitador_namespace) (rate(limited_calls{cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m])) + sum by (cluster, limitador_namespace) (rate(authorized_calls{cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m])))

panels.title: Tokens counted/s by subscription and user
Rate-limit service as seen by the gateway: requests/s, pending, timeouts/s

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, pod) (rate(redis_keyspace_hits_total{cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m])) / (sum by (cluster, pod) (rate(redis_keyspace_hits_total{cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m])) + sum by (cluster, pod) (rate(redis_keyspace_misses_total{cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m])))

panels.title: Redis: rejected connections/s and replicas attached
maas-api HTTP requests/s
panels.description: Label set confirmed after the first scrape; grouping by absent labels only flattens the legend.

panels.title: maas-db (CloudNativePG: primary on the hub, replica on spoke-b)

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, pod) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_database_blks_hit{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace="maas-db"}[5m])) / (sum by (cluster, pod) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_database_blks_hit{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace="maas-db"}[5m])) + sum by (cluster, pod) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_database_blks_read{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace="maas-db"}[5m])))
